VBO:0201261.summary: Lively, inquisitive and fond of company, English and American coated Wheatens often express their affection with bouncy greetings. They can learn quickly while keeping a terrier's independent streak. Their soft, fuller coats belong to the breed's heavier coat group; the American type can be denser still.
VBO:0201261.shortDescription: English and American coated Wheatens pair exuberant greetings with quick minds and a measure of terrier independence.
